title: Transitivity outside a finite interval
statement: Let $b,K$ be natural numbers and let $M,M',M''$ be Boolean-valued functions on the integers. Suppose $M$ and $M'$ agree at every integer other than the integers $b+v$ with $v<K$, and $M'$ and $M''$ also agree at every such integer. Then $M$ and $M''$ agree at every integer other than those integers.
hypotheses_covered: Three Boolean-valued functions on the integers
The first and second functions agree outside the specified interval
The second and third functions agree outside the specified interval
